coordinates.object_orientation: +Z shell axis; narrow base at Z=0 and broad capped end at Z=0.210m. Front -Y, side +X, top +Z. Center XY.

concept.reason: Museum specimen thumbnail plus published metric and university anatomical description sufficiently constrain simple shell form.

taxon: Hippurites, shell-body reference Hippurites radiosus PRI 80129
representation: original low-poly fossil-form reconstruction, composite evidence
scope: Interpretative shell-form reconstruction. Lower valve silhouette and 210 mm scale from PRI 80129. Low flat circular upper valve is genus-level anatomical reconstruction supported by University of Padua, NOT asserted preserved on PRI 80129. No soft anatomy or exact scan claim.

scale.basis: PRI publishes length 21 cm. Width and depth are working proportional estimates from oblique thumbnail, not measured specimen dimensions; modest asymmetry acceptable. Total height includes interpretive thin lid.

required_features: Upright thick cylindrical-conical lower valve, narrow truncated basal point at Z0, gradually expands toward broad circular/oval upper margin. Not a spiral gastropod or sharply triangular spike.
Asymmetric gentle axial curve and subdued longitudinal ribbing plus a few uneven growth bands; use broad geometric features, not phototexture.
Thin low nearly flat circular upper valve closes broad end, with a readable circumferential valve seam. This lid is a sourced genus-level interpretation, not copied specimen preservation.
Three modest longitudinal furrows can be suggested, with weaker radial surface relief on lid. Do not invent large ventilation holes or a central spiral.
No sediment matrix, museum labels, detached chips, or painted registration number.
simplifications: No exact specimen surface reproduction. PRI basal taper and outline guide original mesh; paired-valve restoration is explicitly composite.
Internal pillars, hinge teeth and microscopic radial porosity omitted because closed-shell display hides them and source resolution is inadequate.
Muted chalky beige stone palette is artistic, not original life colour. No downloaded third-party mesh or image texture.
acceptance_focus: Four views show a thick tapering shell approximately 210:115:105, not uniform tube or hollow vase.
Upper lid stays low and approximately planar, distinct rim seam without massive dome.
Prioritize silhouette and valve distinction; do not add costly microdetail or unnecessary concept generation.
